---
name: tsql-migration
description: T-SQL feature matrix and rewrite patterns for SQL Server compatibility upgrades, SQL Server to Azure SQL Database, and SQL Server to PostgreSQL conversions.
---

# T-SQL migration patterns

## 1. Compatibility level upgrades (on-prem SQL Server → newer level)

| Topic | What to check |
|---|---|
| Deprecated syntax | `*=`/`=*` outer joins, `RAISERROR` legacy format, `SET ROWCOUNT` with DML, `TEXT/NTEXT/IMAGE` types |
| Optimizer behaviour | cardinality-estimator changes – flag queries with hints (`OPTION (FORCE ORDER)`, `QUERYTRACEON`) for review |
| Reserved words | identifiers that became keywords – bracket them |
| Change script | `ALTER DATABASE CURRENT SET COMPATIBILITY_LEVEL = {{targetCompatibilityLevel}};` in a post-deploy script |

## 2. SQL Server → Azure SQL Database

| Not supported / different | Rewrite |
|---|---|
| Cross-database queries (`db.schema.table`) | Elastic query, or move into one database; flag for review |
| SQL Agent jobs | Elastic jobs / Azure Automation – move out of the repo scope, flag |
| `xp_cmdshell`, CLR assemblies (UNSAFE/EXTERNAL) | Remove; move logic to the application – flag |
| Linked servers, `OPENROWSET` to files | External data sources / Blob – flag |
| `USE <db>` in scripts | Remove |
| Windows logins | Microsoft Entra ID users (`CREATE USER [x] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER`) |

## 3. SQL Server → PostgreSQL

| T-SQL | PostgreSQL |
|---|---|
| `IDENTITY(1,1)` | `GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` |
| `NVARCHAR(n)` / `NVARCHAR(MAX)` | `VARCHAR(n)` / `TEXT` (UTF-8 database) |
| `DATETIME` / `DATETIME2` | `TIMESTAMP(3)` / `TIMESTAMP(6)`; `DATETIMEOFFSET` → `TIMESTAMPTZ` |
| `BIT` | `BOOLEAN` |
| `UNIQUEIDENTIFIER` / `NEWID()` | `UUID` / `gen_random_uuid()` |
| `GETDATE()` / `SYSDATETIME()` | `now()` / `clock_timestamp()` (check transaction semantics) |
| `ISNULL(a,b)` | `COALESCE(a,b)` |
| `TOP n` | `LIMIT n` |
| `+` string concat | `\|\|` (NULL propagates the same way only with `CONCAT_NULL_YIELDS_NULL ON`) |
| `CREATE PROCEDURE` returning result sets | `CREATE FUNCTION ... RETURNS TABLE` or `PROCEDURE` + refcursor; flag callers |
| `@@ROWCOUNT` | `GET DIAGNOSTICS v = ROW_COUNT` |
| `TRY...CATCH` | `BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN ... END` |
| `#temp` tables | `CREATE TEMP TABLE` (session-scoped) |
| `MERGE` | `MERGE` (PostgreSQL 15+) or `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT` |
| Case-insensitive collation | `citext` or `COLLATE` with nondeterministic ICU collation – decide explicitly |

## Batch separators

`GO` is a client-side batch separator, not T-SQL. Keep it for SQL Server targets; remove it for PostgreSQL.

## Verification

Run the commands in `.appmod/verify.md` (harness jobs) or build the SQL project (`dotnet build`). For PostgreSQL targets also make sure every script is
idempotent (`CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS`, `CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION`) when it is a re-runnable script.
